answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 63193 Country: India Title: Request for suggesting us few good islamic names for a girl child. Question: By the grade of Allah (SWT), a girl child was born to us on 26.12.2015. We are requesting for suggesting us few good Islamic names, with English spelling and meaning, for the girl child. Please suggest the most suitable one. Answer ID: 63193 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 254/194/D=03/1437) Choose any name from among the names of the holy wives and daughters of the holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of God be upon him). Below are a few names, keep the one which you like. Umm Habibah, Kulsum, Khadijah, Juvairiah, Fatimah, Ayesha, Zainab, Mariya, Salma. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
